718. Pippa’s Song

 
T
HE
 year ‘s at the spring,
 
 
And day ‘s at the morn;
 
 
Morning ‘s at seven;
 
 
The hill-side ‘s dew-pearl’d;
 
 
The lark ‘s on the wing;
         5
 
The snail ‘s on the thorn;
 
 
God ‘s in His heaven—
 
 
All ‘s right with the world!
